whenToUse: A finance, savings or banking app landing that needs a calm, trustworthy tone, a goal planner and a security page.
Apps with monthly / yearly plans and a comparison table.
avoidWhen: A playful consumer app — use site-app-01.
A B2B SaaS dashboard product — use site-saas-02.
a11y: The savings projection is announced through an aria-live region.
Give the projection chart a text summary of the final amount for screen-reader users.
